newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Redeco price ceiling set at 99 pesos.
newsitem.headline: Redeco price ceiling set at 99 pesos.

text.p: The Philippine Stock Exchange on Monday set a ceiling on the stock price of Republic Resources and Development Corp (Redeco) at 99 pesos, an official from the exchange said.
The exchange earlier lifted its suspension order on trading of Redeco shares.
"Price ceiling on Redeco shares was set at 99 pesos today," the official said.
New investors of the firm have restructured the operations of Redeco and increased the par value of the shares from one centavos to one peso.
Redeco, formerly a mining firm, has been converted into a holding company with the entry of new investors that include businessman William Gatchalian, other exchange officials said.
"Trading on Redeco was suspended for two-and-a-half years due to non-disclosure of material information and over-issuance of shares," the exchange official said.

"The Securities and Exchange Commission gave us the go signal to lift suspension on the trading of the issue after the company fixed all its problems and complied with the disclosure requirements," the same official added.
For Monday, the exchange has allowed Redeco to "seek its true value" but not exceed 99 pesos.
"For tomorrow and succeeding day, we will allow the 50-40 rule," the official added.
Under existing rules, the exchange freezes the price of an issue if it rises by 50 percent in a single trading day or falls by 40 percent.
